title: notification.automation.run_wake
description: Internal to notification. An automation run parked on a wait (or a retry backoff) is due. Staged as the target of a `platform.schedule.requested` (ADR-0015) and consumed by `notification.consumers.wake_automation_run`, which resumes the run only if `wake_token` still matches the token the run was parked with, so a wake-up delivered twice resumes it once.
